instruction: Change GIMP's tile cache size to 4GB.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the tile cache size to 4GB (4294967296 bytes) in GIMP preferences. The evaluator checks the gimprc configuration file for the tile-cache-size parameter with value 4294967296. Uses existing check_config_status metric and gimp_config_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts GIMP configuration file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric function (check_config_status) correctly parses gimprc format and checks key-value pairs
Expected value (4294967296 bytes) is correct conversion of 4GB to bytes
Postconfig correctly closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config file is flushed to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (tile-cache-size) specified in instruction
Data flow is correct: getter extracts config file path -> metric parses file and checks tile-cache-size key against expected value 4294967296
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor typo in expected.rules: 'type:' should be 'type' (without colon). This doesn't affect functionality since check_config_status doesn't use this field, but it's good practice to fix typos.
